summary: Backend regression + new endpoint tests for FinansMaster iteration 4. 15/15 pytest tests passed (7 pre-existing regression + 8 new: Account PATCH/DELETE with rename cascade, Contact CRUD, aging report structure & bucketization, cashflow/aging CSV export with UTF-8 BOM and Turkish headers, dashboard receivable/payable summary).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py aging_report: bucket target dict is mutated in-place; if bucket=='no_due' it is intentionally skipped from totals but rows still include it (OK). Consider surfacing no_due sums as a separate bucket for reporting completeness.

delete_account does not check if any transactions still reference the account; deleting a used account leaves orphan transactions pointing to a stale account name (bakiye artık hiçbir hesapla eşleşmez). Not blocking but worth guarding (409 or cascade).
seed_data runs on every startup; idempotent via count check but consider extracting to a script or admin route to avoid cold-start latency.
server.py is only ~400 lines but growing; when it crosses ~700 split into routers (accounts, contacts, transactions, reports).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed contacts/accounts/transactions and clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with: export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Covers dashboard (with contacts/receivable/payable), accounts full CRUD incl. name-rename cascade to transactions, contacts full CRUD, aging report structure + bucket correctness (overdue/d0_7/d8_30/d30_plus), CSV exports content-type + UTF-8 BOM, transaction balance reconciliation, and CSV import.
